item.text: {"chapter_id":"7B","draft":{"chapter_id":"7B","answers":[{"question_id":"7B.1","answer":"The shards report repeated ruler-specific public statements later characterized as false, misleading, unsupported, or inconsistent with records, particularly concerning Pegasus surveillance, Ayotzinapa, missing-person figures, crime, military control, and government performance. They also record qualified contrary evidence, including acknowledgment of health disclosures and an apology for prematurely disclosing a Banxico decision. Intentional deception is not established for every statement, and several claims remain allegations or retrospective assessments.","supporting_evidence_ids":["BATCH-0003-E005","BATCH-0003-E011","BATCH-0016-E003","BATCH-0018-E002","BATCH-0026-E016","BATCH-0031-E011","BATCH-0042-E009","BATCH-0044-E008","BATCH-0047-E007","BATCH-0050-E010"],"contrary_or_qualifying_evidence_ids":["BATCH-0008-E004","BATCH-0013-E001","BATCH-0015-E016","BATCH-0015-E018","BATCH-0048-E003","BATCH-0055-E007"],"limitations_and_gaps":["The record is not a complete catalogue of sworn statements, formal testimony, or court findings.","Fact-check classifications and investigative reports do not by themselves prove knowing deception.","Several adverse examples concern institutional conduct or agencies rather than personally verified presidential falsehoods."]},{"question_id":"7B.2","answer":"The record is mixed but leans adverse: the ruler sometimes created investigative bodies, ordered cooperation, acknowledged health information, apologized for the Banxico disclosure, and pursued selected recovery or institutional actions. Conversely, the shards describe repeated denial, minimization, criticism of investigators and journalists, disputed handling of missing-person figures, and unresolved Ayotzinapa and Pegasus matters. An SFP inquiry closed one matter for insufficient evidence and had jurisdictional limits. They do not establish a final finding that López Obrador personally enriched himself or that close family personally profited from office. One conflict inquiry found insufficient evidence within its jurisdiction; some officials or associates were removed, reassigned, investigated, or publicly defended, but complete recovery and accountability are unresolved.","supporting_evidence_ids":["BATCH-0005-E003","BATCH-0006-E007","BATCH-0008-E007","BATCH-0008-E011","BATCH-0016-E021","BATCH-0026-E003","BATCH-0026-E006","BATCH-0046-E008","BATCH-0048-E012","BATCH-0031-E013","BATCH-0031-E014"],"contrary_or_qualifying_evidence_ids":["BATCH-0004-E015","BATCH-0008-E004","BATCH-0013-E014","BATCH-0016-E022","BATCH-0028-E006"],"limitations_and_gaps":["No supplied asset, tax, gift, ownership, contract, emolument, or judgment record proves personal or family enrichment.","Associate and administrative corruption cannot automatically be personalized.","Final recovery and accountability outcomes remain incomplete."]},{"question_id":"7B.5","answer":"The evidence supports concerns that loyalty, personal confidence, political alignment, and military dependence sometimes outweighed transparent professional process, including the appointment of an old friend at Segalmex, reliance on confidants, family-linked influence claims, and delayed or blocked oversight appointments. There are counterexamples, including respected investigative appointments and compliance with a court order appointing COFECE commissioners. The record does not support a comprehensive conclusion about all appointments or universal incompetence.","supporting_evidence_ids":["BATCH-0004-E007","BATCH-0005-E004","BATCH-0018-E015","BATCH-0026-E014","BATCH-0030-E003","BATCH-0046-E008","BATCH-0048-E012","BATCH-0026-E020"],"contrary_or_qualifying_evidence_ids":["BATCH-0003-E017","BATCH-0013-E001","BATCH-0021-R01-E010","BATCH-0026-E014","BATCH-0048-E003"],"limitations_and_gaps":["The evidence is not an appointment-by-appointment competence or process audit.","Some claims concern broader movements, legislatures, military institutions, or subnational actors.","Personal selection for self-dealing is not established for every cited appointment."]},{"question_id":"7B.6","answer":"The ruler initially supported investigative mechanisms, including Ayotzinapa commissions, expert participation, presidential cooperation orders, courts, and selected international or domestic accountability processes. The same period includes reported withholding of military records, investigator withdrawal, interference concerns, delayed oversight appointments, attacks on critics, and efforts weakening or subordinating independent bodies. Personal direction is clearest for formal institutional choices, appointments, and public attacks; authorization of each military or agency obstruction episode is unresolved.","supporting_evidence_ids":["BATCH-0003-E011","BATCH-0003-E015","BATCH-0004-E007","BATCH-0004-E008","BATCH-0004-E009","BATCH-0018-E015","BATCH-0026-E004","BATCH-0026-E014","BATCH-0031-E010","BATCH-0042-E010","BATCH-0047-E013","BATCH-0051-E010"],"contrary_or_qualifying_evidence_ids":["BATCH-0004-E012","BATCH-0004-E015","BATCH-0015-E016","BATCH-0015-E018","BATCH-0021-R01-E009","BATCH-0041-E008","BATCH-0048-E003"],"limitations_and_gaps":["Institutional weakening and military autonomy partly predated the target period.","Formal mandates do not prove implementation.","The record does not resolve personal knowledge, control, or response for every obstruction allegation."]},{"question_id":"7B.7","answer":"The record shows mixed compliance with a materially adverse pattern in selected accountability matters: military nondisclosure, disputed Ayotzinapa cooperation, secrecy measures, delayed or blocked oversight appointments, attacks on critics, and denial or minimization of Pegasus claims.
